transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

My mind keeps getting stuck on the same worrying thoughts about what I might have forgotten or done wrong, and I can’t seem to shut them off even when I’m not at school. It's just getting really exhausting, and I don't know how to make it stop.
Do you find yourself performing any specific rituals or repetitive behaviors, like checking or cleaning, in an attempt to reduce your worrying thoughts?

Yes, I find myself constantly rereading emails, rewriting my lesson plans, and checking my parents' calendars and pill boxes over and over. I feel like if I don't do this, something terrible will happen and it will be completely my fault.
Do these worrying thoughts and the need to perform these rituals interfere with your daily activities, such as your school work or spending time with friends and family?

Yes, they definitely interfere with my life. I've started turning down invitations from friends and leaving family dinners early because I feel like I have to go back and double-check my schoolwork and my parents' schedules. I'm also staying so late at school that my principal noticed how worn out I look and suggested I get some help.
Can you describe a recent situation where you felt overwhelmed by these worrying thoughts, and how you responded to them with your rituals or behaviors?

Just the other night, I got stuck at school late because my brain kept looping on the thought, "What if you wrote the wrong date on the permission slips?" I couldn't bring myself to leave until I sat there and repeatedly rewrote my lesson plans and checked those papers for fifteen minutes straight.
Do you experience any physical sensations or feelings of anxiety when you're unable to perform these rituals or when your repetitive thoughts are interrupted?

When I can't finish my checking, I get an intense wave of dread and a heavy feeling that something terrible is going to happen and it will be completely my fault. I don't really have physical symptoms like a racing heart or shaking, but the mental tension and the feeling of responsibility are just overwhelming.

Can you tell me more about what specifically happens or what you fear will happen if you don't complete these rituals or if your thoughts are interrupted, and how that fear relates to your daily worries?

If I don't complete my checking, I get this intense fear that something terrible will happen and it will be entirely my fault. For instance, I worry that I'll give my dad the wrong medication or make a critical mistake on school permission slips that ruins everything. That terrifying feeling of responsibility is what keeps me completely trapped in those endless loops.
